description: Fix template injection in remaining LLM functions (generate_summary, extract_keywords, extract_entities_topics, merge_content) and fix scanner endpoint returning path to deleted file.
steps: Replace ChatPromptTemplate pattern in generate_summary, extract_keywords, extract_entities_topics, and merge_content with direct SystemMessage/HumanMessage objects to avoid template injection from curly braces in document content.
Remove cleanup_scan() call from scan_document endpoint in app/api/scanner.py so the returned file_path points to an existing file.
Update tests in test_llm.py to mock model.invoke() directly instead of the ChatPromptTemplate chain pattern.
Remove ChatPromptTemplate and StrOutputParser imports from llm.py if no longer used.
Verify all tests pass and ruff lint is clean.
acceptance_criteria: LLM functions use direct Message objects instead of ChatPromptTemplate
Scanner endpoint does not delete the scanned file before returning the response
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
